caseName: Coit Independence Joint Venture v. Federal Savings & Loan Insurance

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 485 U. S. 933.] Motion of Joseph M. Hudspeth for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae, for divided argument, and for additional time for oral argument denied. Motion of United States League of Savings Institutions for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae, for divided argument, and for additional time for oral argument is denied.
